needed.evidence: sidewalk is under 1m wide and partly blocked by obstructions, making it unusable
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous and properly maintained sidewalk of at least 1.5m width on the left side of the road to allow safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: obstruction partly blocks the narrow sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the footway on the left side is clear and accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: uneven sections in the narrow footway pose trip hazards for pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway on the left side to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: no marked crossing visible despite crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install marked pedestrian crossings with dropped kerbs at points of high crossing demand.

needed.evidence: urban road with only some street lighting
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure sufficient illumination along the road for safety, especially in less lit areas.
